page.layout: One printed page, verse in two sections. Top: heading and verse lines of the first poem (In eiusdem Triadis certamen). Below a rule: heading and verse of the second poem (In Sacrificorum cereos & lampadas), with a large initial Q. Left edge is cut away, so some line beginnings are missing or partial.

main_text.l: In eiusdem Triadis certamen.
[illegible, ~6 letters] dice sacrifico pictor pistorque feruntur
Artis certamen constituisse sua.
[illegible, ~6 letters] pictor, Cælum terramque, hominesque, deosque,
Denique quod libuit, pinxerit ista manus.
[illegible, ~6 letters] ego (pistor ait) quod pinso, sibi iusserit iste,
Fit Christi corpus, tute quod, ecce, colis.
[illegible, ~6 letters] (ait pictor) paucas hoc durat in horas.
At nostrum longo tempore perstat opus.
[illegible, ~6 letters] tu (inquit pistor) pictura ludis inani,
Quum nostrum vere corpora pascat opus.
[illegible, ~6 letters] (pictor ait) tu ventri numina pinsis?
Vermibus (at pistor) numina pingis? ait.
[illegible, ~6 letters] Iudex. Satis o, satis o certastis amici,
Quadoquidē hac multis pādere sacra nefas,
[illegible, ~6 letters] domum potius, concordi & pectore, Christos
Iste mihi pingat, pinsat & iste mihi.
In Sacrificorum cereos & lampadas.
Quum sint sacrifici mera tenebra,
Noctis noctua nec tam amet tenebras,
Quam lucem hi fugiunt tenebriones:
[illegible, ~6 letters] ur, seu luce rudunt nefanda sacra,
[illegible, ~6 letters] eu noctis taciti as boant per umbras,
Agunt omnia testibus lucernis?
Nempe ut, quos stolida subinde turba
[illegible, ~6 letters] sint vendere callidi, perennes
[illegible, ~6 letters] isis sufficiat lucerna fumos.

page.notes: The left edge of the page is damaged, so the first letters of many verse lines are lost or uncertain; these are marked illegible rather than guessed. The large initial Q of the second poem is read as Q. Some words are doubtful, such as "Ut" and "Vermibus" and the Greek-like abbreviations, and the scan is too faint to confirm them. Ornamental rules and marks are not transcribed.
